interactive-only-refusal.method: Repository contract tests prove that the exact adapter and bespoke mirror refuse unattended and scheduled execution before reads, provider calls, prompting, or writes

governed-dependency-boundaries.method: Repository contract tests require exact Registry-resolved thesis-observation, thesis-underwriting, and belief-evidence-assessment adapters and prohibit direct or widened writes

provider-semantic-equivalence.method: Compared the exact Claude and Codex adapters with issue #61, parent #46, accepted blockers #50/#57/#58, issue #60's interactive-only precedent, and the living-underwriting and observation model

eligible-environment.method: The configured interactive Trade Journal runtime completed credential-free refusal and contract tests plus the governed read-only thesis preflight on 2026-08-12; absent database, provider, source, sandbox, network, or user presence remains refused or unavailable
